title: Diagonal extension from positively curved surfaces in R3
exact_target: For every compact smooth positively curved surface Sigma in $R^3$, allowing a smooth boundary, and every $p>3$, is its surface extension operator bounded from $L^p(Sigma)$ to $L^p(R^3)$?
